conv_021.speaker: MapleMutiny
conv_021.text: Oi ThistleTolls!!! your {troop_count} men teleported off the bridge?? the goose of Redlice saw everything :O

conv_021.speaker: ThistleTolls
conv_021.text: that was a clean fight, MapleMutiny. your goose has no proof. check your own sightlines before you accuse people.

conv_021.speaker: xX_BoarBargains_Xx
conv_021.text: Easy now. Grudges cost coin ThistleTolls. Who pays for the repairs at {village}

conv_021.speaker: MapleMutiny
conv_021.text: Repairs?? the only thing being repaired is my reputation :D the goose demands a rematch at {town}!!

conv_021.speaker: ThistleTolls
conv_021.text: dyed wool moving fast, MapleMutiny. make an offer or stop shouting in global chat.

conv_021.speaker: xX_BoarBargains_Xx
conv_021.text: Sounds fair to me. I can cover the escort too

conv_022.speaker: CountKabbage
conv_022.text: Dzelmasi fell in two days. Efficient. Your {troop_count} pikemen were not the answer, MoleWarden.

conv_022.speaker: MoleWarden
conv_022.text: Efficient is not the same as lasting. I have watched crossbowmen win a valley and lose the war. Keep your food stocked.

conv_022.speaker: CountKabbage
conv_022.text: Food is a logistics problem. Solved with a wagon train from {village}. Cavalry does the rest.

conv_022.speaker: MoleWarden
conv_022.text: Cavalry does the rest until the ground turns to mud :) Ask anyone who marched through the Ashmarches in spring.

conv_022.speaker: CountKabbage
conv_022.text: Mud is a terrain modifier. My men adapt. Pikes are a relic and the scoreboard proves it.

conv_022.speaker: MoleWarden
conv_022.text: The scoreboard proves only that you pick fights you can win, Count. Pikes hold the line when everything else breaks.

conv_023.speaker: xX_BoarBargains_Xx
conv_023.text: Whoever runs {town} should be someone who knows what things cost. Me obviously.

conv_023.speaker: xX_PatinaSage_Xx
conv_023.text: Knowing what things cost is not the same as knowing what people need, friend. A fief is kept by its farmers, not its ledgers :)

conv_023.speaker: xX_BoarBargains_Xx
conv_023.text: Farmers need coin to pay their taxes. I keep the coin moving. Simple.

conv_023.speaker: xX_PatinaSage_Xx
conv_023.text: You keep the coin moving, yes, but you also keep it in your own purse. I have seen that before in {village}.

conv_023.speaker: xX_BoarBargains_Xx
conv_023.text: Rude. Prove it or drop it

conv_023.speaker: xX_PatinaSage_Xx
conv_023.text: Proof is in the granary books, which I will gladly show to the council. You are welcome to try the same.

conv_023.speaker: xX_BoarBargains_Xx
conv_023.text: Grudges cost coin PatinaSage. Let's talk prices instead. Who wants {town} anyway

conv_024.speaker: HammerhandVow
conv_024.text: SirNutbrook, your banner moved three paces during the charge at {village}. I saw it with my own eyes. Explain yourself.

conv_024.speaker: SirNutbrook
conv_024.text: Dear HammerhandVow, I should like a Word in council. The banner was merely adjusted for the Wind.

conv_024.speaker: FactorAnvile
conv_024.text: Oh dear :) Care for a deal on iron, SirNutbrook? Fair prices :) Let's not sink the whole market over one banner.

conv_024.speaker: Brakken_Mouthy
conv_024.text: lmao nutbrook got caught banner moved 3 paces and he gonna cry in council lol

conv_024.speaker: HammerhandVow
conv_024.text: Brakken, this is not your quarrel. Stand aside, or stand with me. I will not ask twice.

conv_024.speaker: SirNutbrook
conv_024.text: Brakken, your commentary is noted and promptly ignored. HammerhandVow, I invite you to prove your accusation before witnesses.

conv_025.speaker: DameBeaneOfQuel
conv_025.text: Hear me, SerWrenwood. The causeways of Ondrac will not hold themselves. I ask you to ride with my banners to {town}.

conv_025.speaker: SerWrenwood
conv_025.text: Come sit by the fire, my dear :) Campaigns do not begin on a dare, and I would hear your plan before I pledge a single spear.

conv_025.speaker: DameBeaneOfQuel
conv_025.text: A plan? The plan is {troop_count} riders at dawn and the Regency's honour restored. Is that not enough for any true knight?

conv_025.speaker: SerWrenwood
conv_025.text: Honour is a fine cloak, but it is the wagons that win wars :) We will need {gold} for grain alone before the first march.

conv_025.speaker: DameBeaneOfQuel
conv_025.text: Then I shall pay the grain myself. Let the causeways of Ondrac remember this day, and let the bards sing of the Lauresse banners.

conv_025.speaker: SerWrenwood
conv_025.text: Ha! There she is :) Bring your riders to {village} by the new moon, and I will bring the old stories and the good cider.
